curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42114-1-1.pdf (one book; the gearbox is built on pages 6-60, the rear chassis to page 109, the front from page 110; the app's functions page is page 441, the hub's switch and battery access page 438)

functions.does: The XL motor in the rear frame, just behind the articulation, drives all six wheels through the gearbox: the gearbox's output runs back to a centre differential, which drives the front axle's differential through a shaft with universal joints across the articulation, and both rear axles' differentials by a shaft running back between them, to the portal hubs.
functions.source: book: pages 6-60 (gearbox), 67 (overview of the rear chassis), 61-109 (rear axles, portal hubs and the two motors), 204 (step 325: the front axle's differential), 218-220 (steps 340-341: the shaft across the articulation); page 441 (driving forwards and back)
functions.note: the gearbox must be in a driving gear (1, 2, 3 or R) first; which turn of the L motor gives which gear is not known. Pushed along, the wheels turn the XL motor back through the gearbox

functions.does: The L motor beside the XL motor shifts the gearbox: it turns a changeover rotary catch, which slides the gearbox's driving rings to give three forward speeds and reverse (1, 2, 3, R), and a further position that sends the XL motor's drive to the dump body's actuators instead of the wheels.
functions.source: book: page 31 (inset: the changeover catch, in purple, and the driving ring extension), pages 33-60 (the driving rings), page 441 (the H-pattern 1-3 / 2-R gear icon); the tipping position is inferred from the gearbox driving the actuators' shafts
functions.note: which ring each position slides, and the order of the positions, are inferred: the owner should check

functions.does: With the gearbox in its tipping position, the XL motor raises and lowers the dump body: a shaft out of the gearbox turns a pair of bevel gears to two cross shafts, each driving one of the two linear actuators on either side, which push the body up about its pivot at the back.
functions.source: book: pages 85-109 (the actuators' turntable mounts and their drive shafts), pages 340-436 (the dump body), page 437, page 441 (the body tipping)
functions.note: inferred that the dump is worked by the XL motor through the gearbox: the set has three motors (XL, L, large angular) and the actuators' shafts come from the gearbox

functions.does: The large angular motor at the front steers by bending the truck at its articulation: its two cranks push and pull two links on the rear half's hitch, swinging the front and rear halves about the upright hinge behind the cab.
functions.source: book: page 140 (step 221: the angular motor), pages 140-150 (its cranks and links), 218-220 (steps 340-341: the hitch), page 441 (steering left and right)

functions.does: The rear half can roll against the front half on a turntable lying on its side in the hitch, so all six wheels stay on uneven ground.
functions.source: inferred: the hitch's 28 tooth turntable faces along the truck (pages 218-220)

functions.does: The orange beacon on the cab roof switches the hub on and off: turning it turns an upright axle down through the roof to a lever that presses the hub's button.
functions.source: book: page 438 (top: the beacon with turning arrows and the lever on the hub's button)

functions.does: The black hood over the hub tilts forward once the long axle pin at the front bumper is pulled out, giving access to the hub's batteries.
functions.note: which side the hood hinges on is read from the page 438 picture and the model's bonnet hinge axles p2926 and p2927; the owner should check
